_meta.surface: Right pane of /profile page ('Lịch sử đơn hàng' table)
_meta.note: Test data is data-driven via this JSON. Each case is fully described by its fields; the spec reads them in a loop. Each case targets one or more assertion patterns from the suite: (1) toBeVisible, (2) toContainText/toHaveText, (3) toHaveCount, (4) toHaveURL, (5) page.on('dialog') for alert capture, (6) class-name assertion via locator.evaluate, (7) numeric pattern assertion on currency / id formatting.

cases.description: authenticated user with no orders sees the empty-state message
cases.expectedText: Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào.

cases.description: table header 'Lịch sử đơn hàng' is rendered when the user is logged in
table renders exactly 1 row when the user has 1 order
table renders exactly 5 rows when the user has 5 orders (BVA: low-N boundary)
orders are sorted newest-first (descending id) when seeded in ascending order
total amount renders with '₫' suffix and locale-grouped digits (100000 → '100.000 ₫')
status badge for 'pending' order shows localized label 'Chờ xác nhận' and yellow bg
status badge for 'confirmed' order shows 'Đã xác nhận' and indigo bg
status badge for 'shipping' order shows 'Đang giao' and blue bg
status badge for 'delivered' order shows 'Đã giao' and green bg
status badge for 'canceled' order shows 'Đã hủy' and red bg
cancel button is visible for a 'pending' order
cancel button is NOT rendered for a 'delivered' order
cancel button is NOT rendered for a 'canceled' order
clicking 'Hủy đơn' on a pending order fires a success alert and the row's status flips to canceled
unauthenticated visit to /profile renders the 'please log in' message instead of the table
BVA: a 1-VND amount still formats as '1 ₫' with the ₫ suffix
BVA: a 9-digit amount formats with two grouping separators (1.234.567.890 ₫)
isolation: a different user's order does NOT appear in this user's table
